lead_raw_text:
The structure of Hg4S4Se4 (reduced formula HgSSe) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows Hg centers with 8 geometric neighbors (4 S, 4 Se), while S and Se centers each have 10 neighbors, with S coordinated by 4 Hg, 2 Se, and 4 S, and Se by 5 Hg and 5 S. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner- and edge-sharing between S and Se 10-vertex polyhedra, and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among like Hg 8-vertex polyhedra.
